import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Maxflow {
        static class Edge {
            int from, to;
            long flow, capacity;
            Edge(int from, int to, long flow, long capacity) {
                this.from = from;
                this.to = to;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.capacity = capacity;
            }
        }
        
        int s, t;
        List<Edge> edg = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] dist = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] visited = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] cur = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        
        void init() {
            edg.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        void addedge(int from, int to, long capacity) {
            Edge e1 = new Edge(from, to, 0L, capacity);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(to, from, 0L, 0L);
            edg.add(e1);
            edg.add(e2);
            g[from].add(edg.size() - 2);
            g[to].add(edg.size() - 1);
        }
        
        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            visited[s] = 1;
            dist[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = edg.get(g[v].get(i));
                    int nxt = e.to;
                    if (visited[nxt] == 0 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                        dist[nxt] = dist[v] + 1;
                        q.add(nxt);
                        visited[nxt] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return visited[t] == 1;
        }
        
        long dfs(int x, long cp) {
            if (x == t || cp == 0) return cp;
            long flow = 0, newflow;
            for (int &y = cur[x]; y < g[x].size(); y++) {
                Edge e = edg.get(g[x].get(y));
                if (dist[x] + 1 == dist[e.to]) {
                    long minn = Math.min(cp, e.capacity - e.flow);
                    newflow = dfs(e.to, minn);
                    if (newflow > 0) {
                        e.flow += newflow;
                        edg.get(g[x].get(y) ^ 1).flow -= newflow;
                        flow += newflow;
                        cp -= newflow;
                        if (cp == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
        
        long Dinic() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                flow += dfs(s, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }
    
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 7100;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;
    static Maxflow mf = new Maxflow();
    static char[][] g1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] g2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] dist = new int[14][14];
    static int n;
    static int[] tgt = new int[103];
    
    static void BFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 14; j++)
                dist[i][j] = 111;
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{x, y, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            if (visited[p[0]][p[1]]) continue;
            visited[p[0]][p[1]] = true;
            dist[p[0]][p[1]] = p[2];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tx = dx[i] + p[0], ty = dy[i] + p[1];
                if (tx <= 0 || tx > n || ty <= 0 || ty > n || visited[tx][ty] || g1[tx][ty] == 'Y') continue;
                q.add(new int[]{tx, ty, p[2] + 1});
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int index(int level, int x, int y) {
        return level * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
            }
        }
        
        mf.init();
        mf.s = 0;
        mf.t = MAX_SIZE - 2;
        int x = 0, y = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    x = i; y = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (x != 0) break;
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n * n; i++) tgt[i] = MAX_SIZE - 3 - (n * n - i);
        
        BFS(x, y);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] >= '0' && g1[i][j] <= '9')
                    mf.addedge(mf.s, index(0, i, j), g1[i][j] - '0');
                if (g2[i][j] >= '0' && g2[i][j] <= '9')
                    mf.addedge(tgt[index(0, i, j)], mf.t, g2[i][j] - '0');
                mf.addedge(index(0, i, j), tgt[index(0, i, j)], INF);
            }
        }
        
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
                        int tx = dx[l] + j, ty = dy[l] + k;
                        if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && g1[tx][ty] != 'Y' && g1[tx][ty] != 'Z') {
                            if (dist[j][k] >= i && dist[tx][ty] >= i && g1[j][k] != 'Y' && g1[j][k] != 'Z') {
                                mf.addedge(index(i-1, tx, ty), index(i, j, k), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    mf.addedge(index(i, j, k), tgt[index(0, j, k)], INF);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(mf.Dinic());
    }
}
